results.title: Building Pluto for AI Agents, Not Just Humans | Sahil Seth posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.content:
Pluto by talentpluto is an AI voice agent that helps professionals get discovered.
A resume and online profile are not enough for the AI era. Neither captures what someone actually did, what they’re great at, or what they want next.
Professionals talk to Pluto for 10 minutes. It learns their story, makes them discoverable to AI agents, and connects them with the right people when there’s a fit. They stay in control of what gets shared.
For companies, Pluto searches the network and broader market, understands fit on both sides, and makes warm introductions with confirmed interest.
18K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto. 100+ companies use Pluto to meet people with their full story.
